Let \(A\) be the area and set \(k=2A\). Then the sides are
\[
a=\frac{k}{12},\quad b=\frac{k}{15},\quad c=\frac{k}{20}.
\]
The semiperimeter is
\[
s=\frac{a+b+c}{2}=\frac{\frac{k}{12}+\frac{k}{15}+\frac{k}{20}}{2}
=\frac{\frac{12k}{60}}{2}=\frac{k}{10}.
\]
Using Heron's formula,
\[
A=\sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}
=\sqrt{\left(\frac{k}{10}\right)\left(\frac{k}{60}\right)\left(\frac{k}{30}\right)\left(\frac{k}{20}\right)}
=\frac{k^2}{600}.
\]
Since \(A=\frac k2\),
\[
\frac k2=\frac{k^2}{600}.
\]
Thus \(k=300\), so
\[
A=\frac{300}{2}=150.
\]
\[
\boxed{150}
\]
